newsitem.title: USA: Magnum Petroleum privately places preferred.
newsitem.headline: Magnum Petroleum privately places preferred.

text.p: Magnum Petroleum Inc said it agreed to the private placement of $10 million in convertible preferred stock with Trust Company of the West and TCW Asset Management Company, as agent for institutional investors.

Terms of the 1996 Series A Convertible Preferred Stock call for, a fixed annual cumulative dividend rate of 8.75 percent, payable quarterly in arrears commencing December 3l, 1996, convertibility into common shares of the company at a conversion price of $5.875 per share, and if not already converted, an option by the company after two years to exchange the 1996 Series A convertible preferred stock for a convertible subordinated debenture of equivalent value.
Funding of the equity placement is anticipated prior to year-end and will be applied to the company's senior bank credit facility, it said.
